run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T19:38:56Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend-proxy error signal the alert names is real and observable: frontend-proxy carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on its 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' operations (159.15 error spans vs 52481.2 unset spans in the hour ending 2026-11-17T19:55:25Z), and its 5-minute error-to-all-span ratio rose from a ~0.0002–0.0008 baseline to 0.0253/0.0250 around 19:32–19:34. The proxy's own access logs show the failing responses directly: POST /api/checkout returned 500 ('via_upstream') continuously from 19:29:22.285Z to at least 19:31:05.874Z. The failure path the telemetry shows is checkout -> payment: checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans were STATUS_CODE_ERROR (~42.5 per 30 min, all confined to windows ending 19:31:00–19:34:00 and zero by 19:35:00), and checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and frontend's POST /api/checkout / grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans errored in the same interval. This coincides exactly with the payment Deployment's controlled pod replacement: old pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 stopped 19:29:21, new pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d created 19:29:18, and the new container logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 19:30:36.571Z. That payment Deployment rollout changed only the kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt annotation (same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, same env), so the restart is a mechanism, not a cause. The only fault-injection setting found switched on in the workloads' config is ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config flag 'paymentUnreachable' = 'on' (description 'Payment service is unavailable'; the other eleven flags are 'off'), which names the restarted/failing service and no other object was seen applying a change to payment; on that basis the ConfigMap is the leading root-cause candidate, but the declared fault itself was not observed as ongoing (payment served successful charges at 19:42–19:43 with zero error spans while the flag remains 'on') and the time the flag value changed cannot be determined, so the conclusion is partial. Note also that the alert's own rule/expression is not present in the queried Prometheus, so the reported 'current: 0.02222222222222222' could not be reproduced.

claims.text: In the hour ending 2026-11-17T19:55:25Z, frontend-proxy recorded 159.15 STATUS_CODE_ERROR span counts versus 52481.21 STATUS_CODE_UNSET span counts, and its error spans were on the operations 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'; a second service with error spans in the same window was checkout (84.88), frontend (279.78), ad (3.05), recommendation (4.05), fraud-detection (3.05) and payment (0).

frontend-proxy's 5-minute error-span share of its own span counts was ~0.00018–0.00075 in the sampled points from 19:20 to 19:31 and from 19:36 to 19:48, and peaked at 0.02531 (point 19:32), 0.02505 (19:34) — i.e. the deviation is a short burst, not a sustained rise observed across the whole window.

frontend-proxy access logs show the error responses themselves: POST /api/checkout returned '500 - via_upstream' from 19:29:22.285771Z through 19:31:05.874667Z (72 matching 5xx lines in the 19:25–19:36 slice, 40 shown), with per-request upstream latency fields of 9–898 ms, i.e. the upstream frontend answered 500 to the proxy.

Sporadic '503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' lines on product-page GETs also occur outside the burst (19:20:55.272Z, 19:22:12.321Z, 19:25:16.657Z, 19:31:30.903Z, 19:34:46.215Z); these are background noise present before the checkout 500s, not the error signal that changed.

The errored operations in the 30 minutes sampled to 19:55 were: frontend 'POST /api/checkout' (70.65), 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' (70.65), 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (70.65) and 'POST' (70.65); checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (42.41) and 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' (42.46); frontend-proxy 'ingress' (81.91) and 'router frontend egress' (70.65). The deepest failing operation visible is checkout's client call to the payment service.

checkout's payment Charge errors are confined to the restart interval: 5-minute increase was 55.62 (window ending 19:31:00), 51.25 (19:32), 47.75 (19:33), 45.56 (19:34) and 0 from 19:35:00 onward, while Charge calls with STATUS_CODE_UNSET dropped from ~157–180 per 5 min to 91–107 in the same windows; a 30-minute increase query returned 42.46 error vs 899.61 unset.

Kubernetes events in otel-demo record a controlled payment Deployment rollout: ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 SuccessfulCreate 19:29:18Z, Pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d Scheduled 19:29:18Z / Created 19:29:20Z / Started 19:29:21Z, Deployment 'Scaled up replica set payment-54499f9786 from 0 to 1' 19:29:18Z, Pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 'Stopping container payment' 19:29:21Z, ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 SuccessfulDelete 19:29:21Z and 'Scaled down replica set payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0' 19:29:21Z.

The payment rollout left the pod template unchanged apart from a restart annotation: new ReplicaSet payment-54499f9786 (created 19:29:18Z) has template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T19:29:18Z but the identical image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment and identical env (PAYMENT_PORT=8080, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, OTEL_*) as the old ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 (created 18:57:06Z); the payment Deployment is the only otel-demo Deployment at generation 2 for this incident besides flagd (restartedAt 18:59:00Z), all others are generation 1.

The replacement payment container took over a minute to serve: pod payment-54499f9786-4r25d has startTime 2026-11-17T19:29:18Z (container restartCount 0) and its log records 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 2026-11-17T19:30:36.571Z — after the first checkout 500 appeared at 19:29:22.285Z.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) holds a switched-on fault-injection setting: "paymentUnreachable": {"defaultVariant": "on", "description": "Payment service is unavailable", "state": "ENABLED", "variants": {"off": false, "on": true}}. The other flags in the same ConfigMap are at "defaultVariant": "off" — adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure.

The payment service evaluates flagd at runtime (its span names include 'grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat' alongside 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge'), yet it served charges normally after the rollout: its log shows repeated 'Charge request received.' / 'Transaction complete.' pairs from 19:42:50.181Z to 19:43:15.957Z, and its own STATUS_CODE_ERROR span count in the hour ending 19:55:25Z was 0.

Jaeger has no trace coverage for the burst: the newest frontend-proxy traces returned for the whole authorized window start at 19:24:43.584780Z and end at 19:24:48.667131Z (source_start_at/source_end_at), and all their ingress/egress spans carry http.status_code=200; searches of 19:25–19:40, 19:28–19:40 and 19:50–19:55 returned no traces.

All 21 otel-demo pods, including payment-54499f9786-4r25d, frontend-675fd7b5c5-zjtpt, checkout-5dccddf8bb-h9bvp and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-sznks, are Running with container restartCount 0 and empty lastState (queried at ~19:58Z, after the window).

Leading candidate: ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config, holding the switched-on fault-injection setting paymentUnreachable="on" ("Payment service is unavailable") for the payment service, is the root fault; its mechanism was the payment Deployment rollout restart at 19:29:18Z (unchanged pod template) and its consequences were the checkout -> payment Charge failures (19:29–19:31), failing frontend /api/checkout 500s, and the frontend-proxy ingress/egress error-span burst that triggered the alert.

Alternative/complementary candidate: the immediate cause of the observed errors is payment pod unavailability during its replacement — old pod stopped 19:29:21Z, new container only listening at 19:30:36Z — so checkout's Charge calls failed and the error propagated; on this reading the rollout trigger (who/what issued the 19:29:18Z restartedAt rollout) is the unresolved cause.

The declared fault is not observable in effect after 19:31: checkout Charge failures stopped by the window ending 19:35:00, payment logged successful charges at 19:42–19:43 and has 0 error spans, and frontend-proxy's error share returned to ~0.0007 — while flagd-config still reads paymentUnreachable="on". This bounds the observed failure to the pod-replacement interval and leaves the flag's actual runtime effect unverified.

Rejected: payment pod crash, OOMKill or eviction. The events of the window show a Deployment-controlled rollout (ScalingReplicaSet 0->1 and 1->0, ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete, 'Stopping container payment'), not eviction/OOM; the surviving pods all report restartCount 0 and no Evicted/OOMKilled/Failed reason was returned for otel-demo pods.

Rejected as the source of this burst: a broad failure of the other otel-demo services. The 1h error-span query returned error series only for ad (3.05), checkout (84.88), fraud-detection (3.05), frontend (279.78), frontend-proxy (159.15), recommendation (4.05) and payment (0); the ad/recommendation/fraud-detection values are ~1 span per 5 minutes both before and after the burst (background), and email, cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, quote and image-provider returned no error series in that query (no series returned = unknown, not zero).

Advisory: retrieve the change/audit record for the kubectl rollout restart of Deployment otel-demo/payment at 19:29:18Z and for edits to ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (the change_history integration is not available in this Run), confirm what value flagd is actually serving for paymentUnreachable, and, if the flag is not the intended state, set paymentUnreachable back to "off"; separately, add a readiness probe/surge so payment is not removed from Service endpoints before the new container's gRPC server is listening (75 s startup observed).

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not in the queried Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and with type=alert both returned nothing, and no ALERTS/alert_* series exist in the window, so the expression and window behind 'current: 0.02222222222222222' could not be reproduced or verified.

No trace-level error details exist for 19:29–19:34: Jaeger's newest frontend-proxy traces end at 19:24:48.667Z and searches of 19:25–19:40, 19:28–19:40 and 19:50–19:55 returned no traces, so the gRPC status/message of the failing checkout Charge spans is unknown.

Cannot determine when the flagd-config paymentUnreachable value changed: the ConfigMap creationTimestamp is 2026-11-17T18:57:05Z (not a content-change time), the flagd Deployment was rollout-restarted at 18:59:00Z and payment at 19:29:18Z, but no change/audit history is available (change_history not integrated), so neither edit time is evidenced.

The declared fault itself was not observed as an ongoing condition: the config still reads paymentUnreachable="on" while payment served charges successfully at 19:42–19:43 and shows 0 error spans, so whether and when that setting actually took effect is unverified.

The old payment pod payment-55766d76b9-846r8 no longer exists and its previous-instance logs are unavailable, and the frontend pod's log stream returned no lines, so the checkout- and frontend-side error text for 19:29–19:31 is unknown.
Who or what issued the 19:29:18Z rollout restart of the payment Deployment is not evidenced by any object read; the restartedAt annotation records only the time.

Whether any /api/checkout 500s occurred earlier in the window (before 19:20) is unknown: span-metric samples for these series start around 19:15–19:20 and Jaeger traces before 19:24:43 were not returned for the sampled queries.
next_steps: Pull the cluster audit / CI change record for 2026-11-17T19:29:18Z (kubectl rollout restart of Deployment otel-demo/payment) and for edits to ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config, and correlate with the flagd restart at 18:59:00Z.
Query flagd directly (or its evaluation logs) for the effective value of paymentUnreachable as served to the payment and checkout workloads, and reset it to "off" if it is not intended.

If longer-retained tracing exists, inspect error spans from checkout operation oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge between 19:29:20Z and 19:31:10Z to capture the gRPC status code/message (Unavailable vs other) as the definitive causal link.

Review the payment Deployment rollout strategy and readiness probe so the old pod is not terminated before the new container's gRPC server listens (75 s startup observed), which would remove the transient checkout failure path.
